decisions.reason: As a flagship harvesting crate launched only a year ago, its value is still uncertain and keeping it costs little, so the option is worth holding.
The foldable large container line has its own page and fits the firm's core pooling and automotive business, so early uncertainty favors keeping the option open.
Stackable crates are a low-cost addition to a crowded standard range, and with no evidence of failure after one year, keeping them remains cheap.
The rackable pallet line was only mentioned on the website, but tooling is already sunk and the evidence has not yet shown poor value, so it is kept.
The spill-retention pallet serves a niche industrial safety need, its prospects are still unresolved, and its carrying cost is low.
The pallet with load retainers has its own page and is too new for its value to have resolved, so the option is worth more than its upkeep.
